capabilities: browse and search 160,000+ bundled icons with fuzzy matching
organize icons into collections, tags, and favorites
apply icons to files, folders, and tab headers via rules, overrides, and file-type defaults
tint icons with per-rule, per-file-type, and custom colors
import custom SVG icons into a personal pack
disambiguation: Not a bookmarking or note-starring tool; it manages icon collections and applies them to files, folders, and tabs.
extras: The community installer only downloads main.js, styles.css, and manifest.json, so missing icon packs are fetched once from a CDN and cached locally; a full offline install requires copying the packs/ folder from the repo. The 3D Galaxy view requires WebGL. Full-color packs (Twemoji, OpenMoji) keep their own colors and ignore the tint palette. Soundscapes are off by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse large icon libraries and assign icons to files and folders, and existing icon plugins are either purely manual or purely automatic without explaining why an icon appears.

relations.evidence: Iconize gives you total manual control.
Turn any Dataview query into a dynamic icon collection

summary: Icon collection manager that bundles 160,000+ icons, organizes them into collections and tags, and applies them to files, folders, and tabs via a rules engine.
